preconditions: A mail client is configured for the handoff.
flow: Find Kontakta oss för offert; from a service page its inquiry action opens /kontakt/ with that service preselected in Tjänst.
Enter Namn, confirm or change Kundtyp and Tjänst, and describe the project, place and desired timing in Meddelande.

Select Skicka offertförfrågan.
Review and send in the external mail client if it opens.
variants: Customer types are Privatperson, Företag, and BRF eller fastighetsägare.
Services include the five offered areas and Annat.
Pool excavation is part of Grävjobb, not a separate Pool option.

Service-page inquiry actions target /kontakt/?tjanst=<service id> using the typed service record id; contact preselects the matching typed option and keeps manual change available, while direct /kontakt/ and home /#kontakt without context and unknown or malformed context keep the first option without creating new options.
Required fields use browser-native validation; the site has no custom submit handler.
The same typed explanation and subject-bearing fallback email link appear inside the form on home and /kontakt/; aria-describedby associates the note with the form.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The form requests a plain-text mail-client handoff to kontakt@svardentreprenad.se with the configured subject and the actually selected Tjänst option; delivery is not established.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The mail handler may fail to open; the page cannot confirm acceptance or sending.
user_stories.recovery: Use the address linked in the explanation or copy it into working email software and include project details manually; the fallback link still needs an email handler.

preconditions: React has mounted and the page shell is rendered.
flow: Reach Hoppa till innehåll before the repeated header navigation.
Activate the #content link to bypass the header.
Read the routed body or current availability message.
variants: The link is visually hidden until focused, when existing focus styles reveal it.
Ready home, subpage and in-app not-found views share a focusable #content wrapper with scroll margin.
Loading, error and empty states retain one #content section but do not give that section tabindex=-1.
user_stories.expected_outcome: A stable page-body anchor is available before header navigation on all rendered states; ready content has a programmatically focusable destination.
user_stories.failure_behavior: A host error before React mounts cannot offer the link. Availability-state sections have an anchor but no explicit focusability attribute; browser focus/scroll behavior is not established by DOM assertions.
user_stories.recovery: Use ordinary keyboard navigation if anchor behavior is unavailable; a missing static entry document requires host/artifact repair.
